column1: # Real XOVER lines from free.pt, captured 2026-07-28 (Eweka), verbatim.
# Verbatim is the point: a Spotnet header signature covers the exact wire
# bytes of the subject, the From record and the poster nickname, so there is
# no sanitized form of these that still verifies. They are public usenet
# overview lines and the nicknames are public Spotnet handles.
# Format is the raw OVER response line:
#   number \t subject \t from \t date \t message-id \t references \t bytes \t lines
# Lines 0-7 verify, line 8 does not (server-signed spot whose From carries a
# random number instead of a public key - nothing to check it against).
